## Name Etymology

- **AEGIS** (αἰγίς) — divine shield of Zeus and Athena → absolute protection
- **AEGIR** (Ægir) — Norse god of the sea → mastery of flows
- **AEON** (αἰών) — eternity → "Engineered to Last"

Synthesis: "Aegryn protects what endures."

## Core Activities

Aegryn operates across two complementary pillars:

### 1. Swiss Tech Asset Builder
Designs, funds and operates proprietary digital ecosystems (SaaS, B2C, marketplace, social). Full ownership model — no VC dilution. Assets are built to last, not to flip.

### 2. AEGRYN Auction — Tech Asset M&A Platform
Europe's structured auction platform for buying and selling digital tech assets: SaaS businesses, B2C platforms, tech infrastructure. Range: €100K–€50M. Session-based, NDA-gated, graded assets only.

## AEGRYN Auction Platform

### What it is
A structured, session-based M&A auction platform dedicated to European digital tech assets. One of the only platforms of its kind in Europe. Not a broker — a platform with standardised process, grading, NDA and structured closing.

### Process
1. **Seller submits asset** → AEGRYN team grades the asset (AEG★ to B)
2. **Asset listed** in the auction catalog with a confidential dossier
3. **Buyer KYC** → signs NDA → accesses full dossier
4. **Session opens** → competitive bids submitted
5. **Closing** → structured legal process with advisors

### Offer Models (Bid Models)
- **Model 01 — Club Deal**: Lead bidder + up to 4 co-investors, single bid, recommended minimum: €100K
- **Model 02 — Corporate**: Legal entity acquisition (asset deal or share deal), recommended minimum: €250K
- **Model 03 — Fund**: Institutional funds (PE, VC, Family Office, Search Fund), IC window 5–10 days, recommended minimum: €500K
- **Model 04 — Equity Stake**: Partial stake acquisition, no fixed minimum, SHA-based commitment

### Key Pages
- /auction — Platform overview
- /auction/catalog — Live catalog (NDA required for full dossier)
- /auction/how-to-sell — Seller onboarding guide
- /auction/how-to-buy — Buyer onboarding guide
- /auction/sessions — Calendar of auction sessions
- /auction/bid-models — Detailed offer model structures
- /auction/results — Past auction results

## AEGRYN Grade System

Proprietary grading methodology for digital assets. Equivalent to a credit rating for tech companies. Multi-criteria scoring: ARR, NRR, churn, TAM, tech stack, team, IP, compliance.

| Grade | Key | Color | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| AEG ★ | star | #5ADDA4 (mint) | Apex — absolute excellence |
| AAA | aaa | #C9A84C (gold) | Premium |
| AA | aa | #9BA8B0 (silver) | Solid |
| A | a | #4A90D9 (blue) | Standard |
| B | b | #D4820A (amber) | Early stage |

Graded assets only are eligible for the AEGRYN Auction.

Pages: /grade, /grade/methodology, /grade/grading-system, /grade/submit

## AEGRYN Valuation Tool

Free, instant preliminary valuation of digital assets.

Criteria: ARR, NRR, churn, MRR, CAC, LTV, TAM, tech stack, team, IP, compliance.
Benchmarked against European comparable M&A transactions.
Output: indicative valuation range + AEGRYN preliminary grade (B by default until validated).

Page: /valuation

## Expert Network

Curated network of vetted transactional tech experts for M&A due diligence and advisory:

- **M&A Advisors** — deal structuring, valuation, SPA
- **Tech Lawyers** — IP, share deal, asset deal, NDA
- **Accountants/Auditors** — financial due diligence, SaaS metrics audit
- **CTO/Tech Architects** — technical due diligence, code audit, security review
- **Cybersecurity** — PASSI/CREST auditors, penetration testing, ISO 27001
- **HR/Employment Law** — HR due diligence, social audit, GDPR compliance
- **W&I Insurance** — Warranty & Indemnity insurance, transactional risk
- **Tax Advisors** — exit structuring, cross-border taxation, holding optimization
- **Real Estate** — asset-backed real estate in tech transactions
- **ESG/RSE** — sustainability due diligence

Subscription: €89/month excl. VAT (expert listing).

## Philosophy

- **Proprietary** — 100% ownership. No minority VC stakes.
- **Sovereign** — Swiss sovereignty. Our assets, our infrastructure, our data.
- **Durable** — Built for generations, not funding rounds.
- **Precision** — Every decision is documented, measured, traceable.
- **Transparency** — Towards partners, users and the market.
